intent: The dropdown trigger control only: value text + chevron, with an optional leading-icon slot. The menu/list it opens is a separate concern (Menu).
use_when: An inspector field that opens a value list or menu.
You need the canonical trigger anatomy (value, chevron, active ring) rather than a bespoke button.
dont_use_when: You need the option list itself — compose Menu / MenuRow inside the opened surface.
A free-text field — use InputField (Dropdown is a trigger, editable is combo-style only).

slots.leadingIcon: Optional leading icon (rendered in a reserved box; large size gets a secondary-bg chip).

a11y.label: aria-label required (the trigger has no persistent text label of its own beyond the value).
a11y.chevron: decorative; the value text conveys state.
